Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioners are accused in connection with S.T. Case No.14 of 2022, pending before the Court of the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Nimapara, arising out of Nimapara P.S. Case N o .

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Nimapara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: f 2 0 2 1 a l l e g e d c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e s u n d e r S e c t i o n s 363/376-D/323/294/354/354-B/379/34 of IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Nimapara by order dated 03.04.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. This is the second journey of the petitioners to this Court.
5. In the earlier bail application of the petitioners, leave was granted to the petitioners to move afresh after examination of the victim.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed on record the statement of the victim examined as P.W.7.
She has resiled and adverting to the same, petitioners seek release.

7. Learned counsel the State opposes the prayer for bail in view of the statement of the husband of the victim, examined as P.W.6 who has supported the prosecution.
8. Considering that the P.W.7 has resiled, as noted, this Court directs the petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

9. Additionally it is directed that the petitioners shall appear once every week before the jurisdictional police station and learned Trial Court on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial without fail.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Designation: Junior Stenographer
